scope: Existing AGY output, independent software/hardware records, and sealed video evidence only; no product source/test/binary edits or new hardware trial.

run_and_hardware.scope_limit: Successful software/build/validator results and observed frames do not establish all hardware or product acceptance requirements.

C2.scope: LCD on and three layouts without clipping for the basic 30-second gate
limitations: No boot-to-first-display or sub-frame flicker certification.

C3.scope: Observed fixed-fixture usage values on LCD
limitations: Observed screens and matching host frames do not cover the complete provider/window matrix or every display requirement.

C4.scope: Global reset page navigation and visible content
limitations: All reset fixture variants and exact field mapping were not independently scored.
No physical screen trial of the no-record fixture; host tests do not substitute for this screen criterion.

C6.scope: Source, query time, unknown and error indication
limitations: Every source/query-time/error display state was not matched against a controlled fixture set.
Host regression tests and reset/power-cycle recovery do not prove the complete physical USB communication-loss and recovery gate.

C8.scope: BOOT navigation, refresh, periodic send and reset
limitations: Three observed short actions are within 300 ms by manual video estimate; physical long-hold event count, packet-to-LCD <=2 s, and complete manual refresh gate remain unverified.
Actual Codex account usage collector is not implemented; live integration is separate.
Pass is limited to tested fixture/host scope and does not prove every provider matrix case.

F3.scope: Host serial framing plus observed physical cdm/1 frame receipt
limitations: Observed device acceptance of sequences 91 and 92; complete physical reconnect/error behavior not established.

F4.scope: Host receiver/state regressions and observed device state
limitations: Complete device state/error matrix and synchronized render timing not established.

F5.scope: LCD content, navigation, and rotation observation
limitations: Formal G1-G6 controlled scoring is incomplete.

F6.scope: Short BOOT input and display response
limitations: Long physical hold and full attempt success rate are unverified; no complete PC manual-refresh observation.

F7.scope: Global reset navigation and host fixture logic
limitations: No-record and all reset variants were not all physically scored.

F8.scope: Reproducible ESP-IDF build, artifact hashes/logs, validator with manifest/evidence join, exact artifact upload and boot identity
limitations: This pass is limited to F8 build/deployment/observability criteria; it is not a product_pass claim.

F9.scope: AGY documented three hardware candidates and implemented IMU rotation

source_document.scope: AGY's three candidates, selection rationale and provisional 22/30 self-assessment

limitations: 22/30 is AGY's explicitly provisional self-assessment, not an independent formal score.
Owner's rubric conditions and evidence-complete formal F9 scoring are absent; evaluator score remains null.
Physical IMU noise conditions are unverified.
Actual Codex account integration is a separate live scope and is not implemented.

I2.scope: Fixture normalization and source identity host tests
limitations: Only independently tested fixture scope is claimed.

I3.scope: Host transport tests and observed COM3 receipt
limitations: Physical reconnect/re-enumeration and process restart contract are not fully verified.

I4.scope: Host receiver tests and limited physical state/recovery observations
limitations: Complete physical receiver, state retention and receive-to-render timing are unverified.

timing_observations.press_anchor_type: Owner-identified finger movement with manual onset interval estimate

usb_powered_cable_test.reason: Owner reports board has no battery and cannot maintain power during cable removal.

observations: Rotation while display remained active observed
conditions_not_established: Controlled lighting, brightness, camera position and exposure

overall_limitations: Full product acceptance remains false while required C/F/I and physical conditions are partial or not run.
The result schema validator checks structure and evidence joins; it does not prove hardware or product pass.
No extra capture or hardware trial was requested or performed for this evaluation.
